basic_info.description:
Welcome to this stunning corner-unit townhome in the heart of San Franciscos vibrant North of Panhandle neighborhood. This rare offering includes two parking spaces and a private, deeded roof deck.

The main level greets you with a spacious entry and an open, airy layout that flows seamlessly from the living room to the dining area and kitchen. Bathed in natural light from its sunny southwest exposure and enhanced by lofty ceilings, the home offers captivating views of Mount Sutro, creating a bright and uplifting atmosphere.

Upstairs, the primary suite features an updated walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bath with a soaking tub and a separate skylit walk-in shower. A generous second bedroom includes its own en-suite bath and double closet for added convenience.

With an unbeatable Walk Score, this prime location puts you moments from Golden Gate Park, the Panhandle, and the iconic Painted Ladies. Take a trip to the vibrant Divisadero Corridor or the eclectic shops and cafes of Upper Haight, and enjoy the convenience of Trader Joes, Whole Foods, and Target just a short trip away.

Dont miss your chance to experience the best of San Francisco urban living in this rarely available boutique building.
